messages:
kevin: Kicking off serial terraform apply for release v3.4.0 in the 02:00-03:00 UTC change window. Plan: networking + iam stacks. Running: staging -> canary -> prod. Waiting 5m between phases. Tagging @maria @anita for rollback. Please hold all other TF PRs until I merge the post-fix.

deploybot: Scheduled apply confirmed. run-id: run-2048129999. Notifying oncall.

maria: Quick question — did we pin the aws provider? last time an upgrade pulled a new provider and changed routes.

kevin: Yup pinned in root module:
```
provider "aws" {
  version = "~> 4.55"
}
```
I won't run `terraform init -upgrade`.

dexter: If canary fails what’s the exact rollback play? Are we running with serial apply 'bailout' on?

kevin: Bailout is enabled. Manual rollback steps if needed:
```
# grab previous state
terraform state pull > state-prev.json
# restore
terraform state push state-prev.json
```
I'll also have the PR ready to split the large IAM policy if it fails.

deploybot: run-2048129999: apply started on staging. plan: +12 ~3 -0. ETA ~2m.

sam: I'll watch route53/peering routes and monitor metrics. ping me on alerts.

deploybot: staging: apply succeeded (12 add, 3 change). Starting canary now.

anita: Canary failure: iam_role.app-service update failed — attached policy size exceeds 6144 bytes. Terraform error: "Policy document too large". Rolling back canary.

deploybot: canary failed, auto-rollforward disabled. Prod apply halted. run-2048129999 marked with failure in canary. See run log: https://deployments.internal/runs/run-2048129999

kevin: Running rollback to previous state now. Then I'll split the offending policy into two managed policies and open a PR. ETA ~25m.

maria: Good call. After this let's add a CI validation to fail PRs with policy > 6k bytes and a `provider-pin` check in preflight.

dexter: Also add a test that runs `terraform plan` with a dry-run to catch big IAM changes.

deploybot: canary rollback complete; staging unchanged; prod remains halted. run-2048129999 closed as "canary-failed-rollback-complete".

kevin: Filing release note: "Canary rolled due to IAM policy size limit; prod deploy postponed pending policy split and CI validation." Will update once PR merges. Thanks all :thumbsup:
